# CG-REQ-015: Request media type added

The request body accepts a new media type.

**Why it matters:** Additions widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `mediaType.added` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Request media type {mediaType} is now accepted by {operation}.
>
> Existing consumers are unaffected.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: form media type added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/x-www-form-urlencoded: {}, application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Request media type application/x-www-form-urlencoded is now accepted by POST /x.

### Does not fire: no change

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
        requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-015
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
```
